## Precise question / پرسش دقیق

## Prior work and related issues / پیشینه و ارتباط‌ها

## Frozen baseline / نسخهٔ مبنا
Branch, full commit SHA and source paths:

## Hypothesis and falsifier / فرضیه و ابطال‌گر
What observation would reject the hypothesis?

## Allowed experiment / آزمایش مجاز
Use synthetic, read-only or disposable data as appropriate. Specify limits.

## Expected test matrix / ماتریس آزمون
Positive, negative, malformed, changed/rollback and false-rejection controls:

## Explicit nonclaims / ادعاهای ممنوع
What remains UNKNOWN, NOT_ESTABLISHED, or HOLD?

## Requested owner decision / تصمیم لازم
State whether permission for any subsequent implementation is needed. Opening this issue does not itself permit merge, production, signer or trust activation.
